2d.name: First slide
2d.description: Slide the top square along its two neighbours.

2d.name: Around the corner
2d.description: Rotate the end square around its neighbour.

2d.name: Stand up
2d.description: Turn the horizontal chain into a vertical one.

2d.name: Cross to corner
2d.description: Fold the cross into an L. Watch the centre square: it holds the others together.

2d.name: Holding together
2d.description: Straighten the plus into a line. A square that holds the others together cannot move.

2d.name: Staircase
2d.description: Fold the staircase into a corner.

2d.name: Fill the hole
2d.description: Turn the ring around a hole into a solid block.

2d.name: Comb
2d.description: Gather the teeth of the comb into a diamond.

2d.name: Spiral
2d.description: Unwind the spiral into a block.

2d.name: Two rooms
2d.description: Two holes, two cycles: flatten them into a long block.

3d.name: Drop it
3d.description: Slide the top cube down into the corner.

3d.name: Under the arch
3d.description: Fill the gap under the arch.

3d.name: Pillar
3d.description: Bring the pillar down towards the corner.

3d.name: Two layers
3d.description: Compact both layers into the corner. A cube may step just outside the box, but only one at a time.

3d.name: Spatial staircase
3d.description: A staircase climbing in all three directions.

3d.name: Tower
3d.description: A tall pillar in the far corner: bring it down.

3d.name: Bridge
3d.description: Two feet joined by a fragile bridge.

3d.name: Corner pillars
3d.description: Pillars on two sides of the box.

3d.name: Scattered
3d.description: A winding path through all three dimensions.
